text: The Walt Disney Company's 2026 proxy statement names The Vanguard Group (8.5%) and BlackRock, Inc. (6.9%) as the only holders of more than 5% of its common stock, and states that no other person or entity is the beneficial owner of more than 5% of its voting power.
